annotations.title: Sign and send a token launch

description: Sign the launch from build_token_launch_tx with the local key and send it (spends the creation fee and the optional first buy from that wallet). The wallet must be the one passed to build_token_launch_tx. Returns the hash/signature: then call the platform MCP tool submit_launch_tx with it.

launch.description: The whole answer of the platform MCP tool build_token_launch_tx (Transaction/Approvals or SolanaLaunch).
